To find the left-hand limit as \(x\to 1^-\), look at the graph for values of \(x\) just less than \(1\).

As \(x\) approaches \(1\) from the left, the curve approaches the open circle at \((1,0)\). The open circle means the limit is \(0\), even though the actual function value at \(x=1\) is the filled point at \((1,-2)\).

\[
\boxed{\lim_{x\to 1^-} f(x)=0}
\]
